name: Smart Diff groups the seeded PR and deep-links a finding from an unanchored chip
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab (defaults to Normal — no findings visible), switch to Smart Diff, confirm the Core logic / Boilerplate group headers render, then click the seeded finding chip. Every seeded pr_files row has `patch = NULL` (seed.ts), so the finding on src/config.ts has no rendered diff line and surfaces in FileCard's 'unanchored findings' fallback instead of on line 12 — same click, same onOpenFinding handler as an anchored chip. The click deep-links to the Agent runs tab with the finding's card expanded (requirement 4). Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
